entities.summary: Shoji Kokami (b. 1958-08-02, Niihama) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Niihama and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, poets & playwrights, asia.
